headline: Middlebox signatures register at 1.33% in the current OONI window
dek: The decomposition separates interference signatures from transport failure and tests that could not execute.

claims.statement: The current measurement-weighted middlebox index is 1.33%.

method.summary: rates are computed over COMPLETED tests only (measurement_count - failure_count). OONI's anomaly counter ranges only over completed runs, so a test that never completes has no anomaly rate — it has an execution-failure rate, reported separately

limitations: The index is a weighted aggregate over reporting tests; transport failure and execution blackout remain separate categories.
